export const SDKX_KW=new Set("as async await break case catch class const continue debugger declare default delete do else enum export extends false finally for from function if implements import in infer insta\
nceof interface keyof let namespace new null of readonly return static super switch this throw true try type typeof undefined unique var void while with yield abstract".split(" "));

export const SDKX_RE_AFTER=new Set("return typeof case do else in of new delete void throw instanceof yield await".split(" "));

export const SDKX_PUNCT=[">>>=","...","===","!==","**=","<<=",">>=",">>>","&&=","||=","??=",
"=>","==","!=","<=",">=","&&","||","??","?.","++","--","+=","-=","*=","/=","%=","&=","|=","^=","**","<<",">>"];

test(prev.v);return false};const skipStr=(j,q)=>{j++;while(j<n){const c=src[j];if(c==="\\"){j+=2;continue}if(c===q||c==="\n")return c===q?j+1:j;j++}return n};const skipTpl=j=>{j++;while(j<n){const c=src[j];if(c==="\\"){j+=2;continue}if(c==="`")return j+1;if(c==="$"&&src[j+1]==="{"){j+=2;let d=1;while(j<n&&d>0){const e=src[j];if(e==="'"||e==='"'){j=skipStr(j,e);continue}if(e==="`"){j=skipTpl(j);continue}
if(e==="{")d++;else if(e==="}")d--;j++}continue}j++}return n};const push=(t,v,s)=>{const tok={t,v,s};out.push(tok);if(t!=="ws"&&t!=="cm")prev=tok};while(i<n){const c=src[i];const s=i;if(c===" "||c==="	"||c==="\n"||c==="\r"||c==="\f"||c==="\v"||c==="\xA0"||c==="\uFEFF"){while(i<n&&/\s/.test(src[i]))i++;push("ws",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="/"&&src[i+1]==="/"){while(i<n&&src[i]!=="\n")i++;push(
"cm",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="/"&&src[i+1]==="*"){const e=src.indexOf("*/",i+2);i=e===-1?n:e+2;push("cm",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="'"||c==='"'){i=skipStr(i,c);push("str",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="`"){i=skipTpl(i);push("tpl",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(c==="/"&&regexOk()){let j=i+1;let cls=false;let ok=false;while(j<n){const e=src[j];if(e==="\n")break;if(e==="\\"){j+=2;
continue}if(e==="[")cls=true;else if(e==="]")cls=false;else if(e==="/"&&!cls){ok=true;break}j++}if(ok){j++;while(j<n&&/[a-z]/i.test(src[j]))j++;i=j;push("re",src.slice(s,i),s);continue}}if(/[0-9]/.test(c)||c==="."&&/[0-9]/.test(src[i+1]||"")){const m=/^(?:0[xXbBoO][0-9a-fA-F_]+n?|(?:[0-9][0-9_]*\.?[0-9_]*|\.[0-9][0-9_]*)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?n?)/.exec(src.slice(i,i+64));i+=m?m[0].length:1;push("num",
src.slice(s,i),s);continue}if(idStart(c)){while(i<n&&idPart(src[i]))i++;const v=src.slice(s,i);const afterDot=prev&&prev.t==="p"&&(prev.v==="."||prev.v==="?.");push(SDKX_KW.has(v)&&!afterDot?"kw":"id",v,s);continue}let p=c;for(let k=0;k<SDKX_PUNCT.length;k++){const q=SDKX_PUNCT[k];if(src.startsWith(q,i)){p=q;break}}i+=p.length;push("p",p,s)}for(let k=0;k<out.length;k++){if(out[k].t!=="id")continue;
let j=k+1;while(j<out.length&&out[j].t==="ws")j++;if(out[j]&&out[j].t==="p"&&out[j].v==="(")out[k].fn=true}return out};

export const SDKX_TOK_CLASS={kw:"sdkx-k",str:"sdkx-s",tpl:"sdkx-s",num:"sdkx-n",cm:"sdkx-c",re:"sdkx-r"};
